mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (3-month change) compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital declines for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized inflation exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate and decline in payroll employment signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by at least 0.1pp and PAYEMS falls by at least 10k over 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime (HOUST above 1300 thousand units), strong residential construction activity signals robust consumer spending and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals stronger labor market conditions and higher consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth exceeds 1.5% year-over-year, it signals robust supply capacity and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY growth exceeds 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) combined with a stable federal funds rate (3-month change < 0.1%) signals inadequate monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS 3-month change < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong GDP growth regime (GDPC1 above 22500 billion dollars), robust economic expansion supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 22500.
